changelog: "My feedback" (`/account/feedback`, linked from the feedback panel and `/account`): a person reads back the reports they sent — type, their description, the page path, the status and the team's note — through `GET /api/support/reports` and `GET /api/support/reports/[id]` (own reports only; another person's or org's id is 404; never files, context or GitHub links). The admin's status note to the reporter is now kept on the report (`SupportReport.reporterNote` / `reporterNoteAt`, new nullable columns) so it can be shown there (#3877).

en: Feedback: you can now see the bug reports and feedback you sent, their status and the team's reply, under "My feedback".
tr: Geri bildirim: gönderdiğin hata bildirimlerini ve geri bildirimleri, durumlarını ve ekibin yanıtını artık "Gönderdiğim geri bildirimler" altında görebiliyorsun.
de: Feedback: Unter „Meine Rückmeldungen“ siehst du jetzt deine gesendeten Fehlermeldungen und Rückmeldungen, ihren Stand und die Antwort des Teams.
